local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")

local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandWorld")
if world then world:Destroy() end
world=Instance.new("Folder");world.Name="GrowIslandWorld";world.Parent=workspace

local event=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandFeedback")
if not event then event=Instance.new("RemoteEvent");event.Name="GrowIslandFeedback";event.Parent=ReplicatedStorage end

local function part(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
 local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos;p.Anchored=true;p.Color=color;p.Material=material;p.Parent=parent or world;return p
end
local base=workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate");if base then base:Destroy() end
part("StarterIsland",Vector3.new(54,4,54),Vector3.new(0,18,0),Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
part("IslandEarth",Vector3.new(50,7,50),Vector3.new(0,12.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(95,68,48),Enum.Material.Ground)
local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation");spawn.Name="IslandSpawn";spawn.Size=Vector3.new(7,1,7);spawn.Position=Vector3.new(0,21,15);spawn.Anchored=true;spawn.Neutral=true;spawn.Transparency=.35;spawn.Parent=world
local core=part("EnergyCore",Vector3.new(7,7,7),Vector3.new(0,24,0),Color3.fromRGB(90,180,255),Enum.Material.Neon);core.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Brightness=2;light.Range=22;light.Parent=core
local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");prompt.Name="GrowPrompt";prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - 10 Energy";prompt.ObjectText="Energy Core";prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.25;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=14;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=core

local stages={}
local function hidden(name,size,pos,color,material)
 local p=part(name,size,pos,color,material);p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false;table.insert(stages,p);return p
end
hidden("Expansion1",Vector3.new(34,3,28),Vector3.new(38,18.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(76,137,66),Enum.Material.Grass)
hidden("Expansion2",Vector3.new(30,3,30),Vector3.new(-38,18.5,-8),Color3.fromRGB(75,132,65),Enum.Material.Grass)
hidden("Bridge",Vector3.new(45,2,9),Vector3.new(0,18,49),Color3.fromRGB(118,86,56),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
hidden("TreasureIsland",Vector3.new(34,4,34),Vector3.new(0,18,78),Color3.fromRGB(72,126,62),Enum.Material.Grass)
local costs={10,30,70,140}

local forest=Instance.new("Folder");forest.Name="ForestExpansionDecor";forest.Parent=world
local forestObjects={}
local function hiddenDecor(p)
 p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false;table.insert(forestObjects,p);return p
end
local function tree(x,z,s)
 local h=7*s
 hiddenDecor(part("ForestTrunk",Vector3.new(2*s,h,2*s),Vector3.new(x,20+h/2,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,62,39),Enum.Material.Wood,forest))
 local c=hiddenDecor(part("ForestLeaves",Vector3.new(7*s,7*s,7*s),Vector3.new(x,20+h+2.4*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(52,118,58),Enum.Material.Grass,forest));c.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end
local function rock(x,z,s)
 hiddenDecor(part("ForestRock",Vector3.new(4*s,3*s,4*s),Vector3.new(x,20+1.5*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(82,91,92),Enum.Material.Rock,forest))
end
tree(32,-8,.85);tree(42,8,1);tree(49,-5,.72);tree(35,9,.65)
rock(45,3,.75);rock(30,4,.55);rock(50,9,.5)
for _,z in ipairs({-10,0,10}) do
 local f=hiddenDecor(part("ForestFlower",Vector3.new(.7,1.1,.7),Vector3.new(38,21,z),Color3.fromRGB(255,180,225),Enum.Material.Neon,forest));f.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end

local function revealForest()
 local land=stages[1]
 land.Position=Vector3.new(38,10,0);land.Transparency=0;land.CanCollide=true
 TweenService:Create(land,TweenInfo.new(1.15,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=Vector3.new(38,18.5,0)}):Play()
 task.delay(.7,function()
  for i,p in ipairs(forestObjects) do
   task.delay(i*.07,function()
    if p.Parent then p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true end
   end)
  end
 end)
end
local function showStage(n)
 if n==1 then revealForest();return end
 local p=stages[n];if p then p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true end
end

local function spawnOrb()
 if not world.Parent then return end
 local orb=Instance.new("Part");orb.Name="EnergyOrb";orb.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;orb.Size=Vector3.new(2.2,2.2,2.2);orb.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;orb.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80);orb.Anchored=true;orb.CanCollide=false;orb.Position=Vector3.new(math.random(-22,22),22,math.random(-22,22));orb.Parent=world
 local glow=Instance.new("PointLight");glow.Brightness=1;glow.Range=8;glow.Parent=orb
 local taken=false
 orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if taken then return end
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent);if not player then return end
  local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy");if not energy then return end
  taken=true;energy.Value+=1;orb:Destroy()
 end)
 task.delay(25,function() if orb.Parent then orb:Destroy() end end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=Instance.new("Folder");stats.Name="leaderstats";stats.Parent=player
 local energy=Instance.new("IntValue");energy.Name="Energy";energy.Value=0;energy.Parent=stats
 local stage=Instance.new("IntValue");stage.Name="IslandStage";stage.Value=0;stage.Parent=player
end)

local busy={}
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 if busy[player] then return end;busy[player]=true
 local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
 local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if energy and stage and stage.Value<#costs then
  local cost=costs[stage.Value+1]
  if energy.Value>=cost then energy.Value-=cost;stage.Value+=1;showStage(stage.Value);event:FireClient(player,"Upgrade")
  else event:FireClient(player,"NotEnough") end
  if stage.Value<#costs then prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - "..costs[stage.Value+1].." Energy" else prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" end
 end
 task.wait(.3);busy[player]=nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
 while world.Parent do
  local count=0;for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do if v.Name=="EnergyOrb" then count+=1 end end
  if count<18 then spawnOrb() end
  task.wait(1.1)
 end
end)
print("Grow the Island - Forest Expansion build loaded")

local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local old=world:FindFirstChild("IslandDecor");if old then old:Destroy() end
local decor=Instance.new("Folder");decor.Name="IslandDecor";decor.Parent=world
local function part(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
 local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos;p.Anchored=true;p.Color=color;p.Material=material;p.Parent=parent or decor;return p
end
local TOP=20
local function tree(x,z,s)
 local h=7*s
 part("TreeTrunk",Vector3.new(2*s,h,2*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h/2,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,62,39),Enum.Material.Wood)
 local c=part("TreeCrown",Vector3.new(7*s,7*s,7*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h+2.6*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(64,126,65),Enum.Material.Grass);c.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end
local function rock(x,z,s)
 local h=3*s
 local r=part("Rock",Vector3.new(4*s,h,4*s),Vector3.new(x,TOP+h/2,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,98,104),Enum.Material.Rock);r.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,math.random(0,180),0)
end
tree(-18,-15,.9);tree(18,-12,1.05);tree(-19,14,.75);tree(19,15,.8)
rock(-11,-20,.8);rock(14,18,.65);rock(20,3,.55);rock(-20,1,.7)
part("CorePedestal",Vector3.new(10,1.5,10),Vector3.new(0,20.75,0),Color3.fromRGB(62,69,82),Enum.Material.Slate)
local ring=part("CoreRing",Vector3.new(.6,11,11),Vector3.new(0,21.55,0),Color3.fromRGB(75,165,255),Enum.Material.Neon);ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder;ring.CanCollide=false
local sign=part("WelcomeSign",Vector3.new(12,5,.7),Vector3.new(0,22.5,-22),Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
local surface=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");surface.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back;surface.Parent=sign
local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;text.Text="GROW THE ISLAND\nCollect Energy • Upgrade the Core";text.TextWrapped=true;text.TextScaled=true;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,210);text.Parent=surface
